goals.title: Stitch design + screen generation
goals.objective: Create Stitch project, configure Modern dev-tool dark design system, generate landing page screen via generate_screen_from_text, capture screen id.

goals.title: Extract to static HTML/CSS
goals.objective: Use Stitch extract-static-html to land self-contained HTML+CSS into docs/ in the repo working tree.

goals.title: Localize content + polish
goals.objective: Edit copy and links to match the locked content scope (real repo URL, exact install snippet, real overrides table, real cmux version). Verify in browser at desktop and mobile widths.

goals.title: Publish + enable Pages + verify live
goals.objective: Commit docs/ to main, push, enable Pages source=main /docs via gh api, curl live URL and confirm 200 + expected strings.

goals.title: Final gate
goals.objective: Run ai-slop-cleaner, rerun verification, run code-review on the diff; pass quality-gate-json with APPROVE + CLEAR.

claudeObjective: Complete all ultragoal stories in .omc/ultragoal/goals.json: G001-stitch-design-screen-generation Stitch design + screen generation; G002-extract-to-static-html-css Extract to static HTML/CSS; G003-localize-content-polish Localize content + polish; G004-publish-enable-pages-verify-live Publish + enable Pages + verify live; G005-final-gate Final gate
